What coverages does this policy have?

[ANT-PA-204517](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKdxtAAC/view) is a Personal Auto policy with **six coverages**. It covers the 2022 Toyota RAV4 and the 2019 Honda Accord, and the annual premium is **$2,380**.

| Coverage | Limit | Deductible | Premium |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bodily Injury Liability | $300,000 per person | none | $833.00 |
| Property Damage Liability | $100,000 per occurrence | none | $357.00 |
| Collision | Actual cash value | $500 | $666.40 |
| Comprehensive | Actual cash value | $500 | $285.60 |
| Uninsured Motorist | $300,000 per person | none | $142.80 |
| Medical Payments | $5,000 per person | none | $95.20 |

Endorsements also add Roadside Assistance (+$36) and Rental Reimbursement (+$54). There is a Multi-Policy Discount (−$190) and a loss payable clause for Great Plains Credit Union on the RAV4.
